purpose: Stable GitHub execution taxonomy and projection contract. This file does not own capability lifecycle, roadmap scope, verification, or deployment state.

issue_labels.policy: Labels classify and route work. They never promote capability lifecycle or replace structured Project fields.

required.name: type:bug
required.description: Defect in implemented behavior or project tooling

required.name: type:feature
required.description: Bounded product or platform implementation work

required.name: type:governance
required.description: Project authority, contracts, registries or process

required.name: type:maintenance
required.description: Dependency, CI, documentation or operational maintenance

required.name: area:data
required.description: Canonical data, migrations or data contracts

required.name: area:design
required.description: Design Authority, tokens, patterns or visual evidence

required.name: state:blocked
required.description: Execution is blocked by an explicit dependency

required.name: state:needs-evidence
required.description: Implementation exists but required evidence is incomplete

required.name: risk:data-migration
required.description: Canonical or persistent data migration risk

milestones.policy: Milestones represent delivery checkpoints or release objectives, not capabilities, areas, priorities or verification claims.

agents.policy: Agent profiles are repository-owned instructions only. Their presence does not mean the service is enabled or that any agent action is verified.
rules: Agents must read repository authority before acting.
Agents must work through bounded Issues and pull requests.
Agents must not mutate capability lifecycle from Project or Issue state.
Agents must not merge, deploy, rotate secrets or perform destructive actions without explicit human authorization.
Agents must report proposed, approved, implemented, verified and deployed as distinct states.
